configure-server.name: configure-server
configure-server.description: Configure channels, languages and more for your server notifications

languages.label: Notification Languages
languages.description: One or more languages in which the notifications will be posted

tone.label: Bot Tone
tone.description: The tone the bot will use when sending messages in this server

channel.label: Notification Channel
channel.description: The channel to which the bot will post notifications to

name.name: name
name.description: A unique name for this notification

ensure-performances-available.name: ensure-performances-available
ensure-performances-available.description: Control if movies without any announced performances are included in the search

genre.name: genre
genre.description: Only movies with the selected genre will be matched

min-vote-average.name: min-vote-average
min-vote-average.description: The min. TMDB vote average to movie must have, from 0 to 10 (decimals included)

recurrence-pattern.name: recurrence-pattern
recurrence-pattern.description: The pattern after which the notification can be triggered again

recurrence-interval.name: recurrence-interval
recurrence-interval.description: The value used for the recurrence pattern

configure-server.validation-failure:
One or more of your provided options are invalid:<% it.issues.forEach(function(issue) { %>
**<%= issue %>**<% }) %>
configure-server.languages:
All provided languages must be one of the following types: <% it.languages.forEach(function(language) { %>
- **<%= language %>**<% }) %>
configure-server.tone:
The provided bot tone must be one of the following types: <% it.tones.forEach(function(tone) { %>
- **<%= tone %>**<% }) %>

notification-create.validation-failure:
One or more of your provided options are invalid:<% it.issues.forEach(function(issue) { %>
**<%= issue %>**<% }) %>
notification-create.name: A unique name between `1` and `255` characters is required
notification-create.duplicate-name: A notification with the name **<%= it.name %>** already exists
notification-create.search-key: The search key must have between `1` and `255` characters
notification-create.genre: The genre must be a valid genre supported by the bot
notification-create.min-vote-average: The min. vote average must be a number between `0` and `10`
notification-create.recurrence-pattern:
The provided recurrence pattern must be one of the following types: <% it.recurrencePatterns.forEach(function(pattern) { %>
- **<%= pattern %>**<% }) %>
notification-create.recurrence-interval: The recurrence interval must be a number greater than `0`
notification-create.filter-required:
At least one of the following filters must be defined:
- `search-key`
- `genre`
- `min-vote-average`
